resources.string: Detects the Home button / Fire launcher and opens your chosen launcher or kid app. Required for KidsHome to work on Fire tablets where the default launcher cannot be changed.
Disable while Menu is held (hardware only)
KidsHome needs its accessibility service enabled to detect Home and replace the Fire launcher. Enable \"KidsHome home detection\" in Accessibility settings, or via ADB (see README).
Accessibility service is OFF — tap to open settings
No launcher selected (or it was uninstalled). Pick one below.
Kid mode is ON. PIN required to change settings.
Home replacement is inactive. Tap to re-enable the service.
Kid mode is active. Enter the parent PIN to continue.
Choose a 4–8 digit PIN. You will need it to exit kid mode or open KidsHome settings.
Create a PIN before enabling kid mode
Kid mode is locking this tablet. Enter the parent PIN to open KidsHome.

Limits: KidsHome uses accessibility — it is not a true device-owner / MDM lock. A tech-savvy child, ADB, or force-stopping the app can still bypass it. Use it as a convenience aid, not a security boundary.

Emergency exit (works even when locked to a single app):
• Tap the top-right corner of the screen 5 times quickly, or
• Hold the Back button for about 3 seconds.
Then enter the parent PIN. The corner gesture needs “Display over other apps” permission.
Select a kid app or choose launcher lock
5 quick taps in the top-right corner (needs overlay permission)
Enable at least one emergency exit option
Enter the parent PIN to leave kid mode or open KidsHome.
Wrong PIN. Wait %1$d s before trying again.
Incorrect PIN (%1$d failed attempts). Try again.
What would you like to do?

The corner-tap escape needs “Display over other apps”. You can grant it now, or rely on holding Back. On Fire OS you can also run:\nadb shell appops set io.github.marcelsavegnago.kidshome SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
Grant overlay via Settings or:\nadb shell appops set io.github.marcelsavegnago.kidshome SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
Kid mode will enable. Grant overlay later for corner taps; Back-hold still works.

KidsHome is a GPL-3 home-button helper for Amazon Fire tablets where the default launcher cannot be changed.\n\nIt is based on LauncherHijack by BaronKiko and Launcher Replacer by Meems33 / WhiteRaven777.
